label: Does the actual self-knowing source affirm its own possessed goodness?
summary: On c1a5bfea, isolated the self-case of the registered LOVE_1 route. The source identified as GOD_4, its will and good in esse, and the two open own-good and love-reading premises suffice without creature-directed willing. Tested the distinct sense LOVE_3 in Scratch/self-knowledge-love/OwnGood.lean. Given pure actuality, actual inward exercise at a principal good or unfulfilled potency in that respect, identity of that principal intentional object with this very source's own good, and possession, the episode affirms that good or delights in it. The positive unit example realizes affirmation without seeking that good, delight or an additional subject. Self-knowledge, the open evaluative-reading adapter and the possession-sensitive ranking yield at most an available response with the separate calibration and availability premises. The disjunction, its interpretation and the single-subject example are scratch Lean evidence, without a new graph edge. Assessment and rival arguments in docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md#from-self-understanding-to-love-of-ones-own-good.
blocker: At the same source, what warrants actual inward appetitive orientation, and what makes its own goodness under that description its principal end? Practical pursuit for an end supports actual orientation where it occurs. A contemplative intellect whose effects follow from nature explains the given cognition without source-level end-adoption. Even actual generic good-directedness does not identify its intentional object. Test whether this source's activity is intelligible as actually guided by its own goodness as end. Actual delight would require an interpretive bridge to affirmation. A standing reflexive affirmation is intelligible with one lover; a subsistent personal term of origin needs distinct support.
